categories.category: 关于中国开源地图 / About
categories.content:
中国开源地图由开源社维护，帮助访问者发现源于中国的开源软件、模型权重、数据集、开放标准与社区/组织，了解其原始来源、许可范围与当前归属。

Chinese Open Source Landscape, maintained by KAIYUANSHE, helps visitors discover Chinese-origin open source software, model weights, datasets, open standards and communities, with original sources, scoped license information and current stewardship.

本站持续收录中，并非完整的中国开源生态名录。首批数据于 2026-10-15 获准收录，包含 28 个软件、1 个模型权重和 1 个社区。类型支持范围不等于当前已有全部类型或地域的真实条目。

This is an evolving catalog, not an exhaustive directory. The pilot approved on 2026-10-15 contains 28 software entries, one model-weight entry and one community. Supported entry types and regions do not imply complete coverage.

categories.category: 起源、归属与来源 / Origin and sources
categories.content:
起源范围包括中国大陆、香港、澳门、台湾，按公开证据分别记录。历史起源与当前维护组织、基金会归属分开；符合条件的条目在迁移到海外组织或基金会后仍可收录。收录不代表隶属开源社，也不构成认证、质量保证或任何基金会的背书。

Origin covers mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan, recorded separately using public evidence. Historical origin is distinct from current stewardship. A qualifying entry can remain listed after transfer to an overseas organization or foundation. Inclusion does not imply affiliation with KAIYUANSHE, certification, a quality guarantee or foundation endorsement.

本站保留官方名称和原始入口。软件代码、模型权重、数据与标准正文的许可分别核验；组织身份的许可证为“不适用”。项目及商标属于各自权利人，网站代码、编辑内容和品牌素材不共用一项笼统授权。

Official names and original entry points are retained. Licenses are verified for the specific code, weights, data or standard text; licenses for organization identity are not applicable. Projects and trademarks belong to their respective rights holders. Website code, editorial content and brand assets have distinct terms.

网站基于 CNCF Landscape2 开源生成器改造，保留其许可证和版权声明。This site is based on CNCF Landscape2, with its license and copyright notices retained.

  • 收录建议、信息纠错与问题反馈 / Suggest an entry or report an issue

提交时请提供条目名称或链接、需更正的字段和可公开核验的依据。提交建议不等于自动收录；内容经审核后才发布。请勿在公开 Issue 中提交私人联系方式或非公开材料。

Please include the entry name or link, the field to correct and publicly verifiable evidence. Suggestions are reviewed before publication. Do not post private contact information or non-public materials in public issues.
